topicName: Inventory Management: Static vs Dynamic Inventories
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Inventory Management: Static vs Dynamic Inventories in Ansible"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Ansible needs to know which machines it should manage. This is achieved through inventories. An inventory file defines the hosts and groups of hosts upon which commands, modules, and tasks in a playbook operate. Understanding the difference between static and dynamic inventories is crucial for scaling your infrastructure automation."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"What is a Static Inventory?"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"A static inventory is a manually maintained file written in INI or YAML format. It contains hardcoded IP addresses or domain names of your target servers, often organized into logical groups like webservers or databases."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"[webservers]
192.168.1.10
192.168.1.11

[databases]
192.168.1.20"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"When to Use Static Inventories"},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Small-scale environments with infrequent infrastructure changes."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"On-premise servers with fixed IP addresses and rigid topologies."},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Testing, development, or lab environments where simplicity is paramount."},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"What is a Dynamic Inventory?"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"In modern cloud environments, infrastructure scales dynamically. Instances spin up and down constantly, making static files obsolete. A dynamic inventory pulls host information in real-time from external sources such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or CMDB systems using inventory plugins or scripts."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"plugin: amazon.aws.aws_ec2
regions:
  - us-east-1
keyed_groups:
  - key: tags.Environment
    prefix: env"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Benefits of Dynamic Inventories"},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automated synchronization with cloud providers eliminating manual updates."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Seamless integration with auto-scaling groups and ephemeral environments."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Rich metadata collection allowing targeted execution based on cloud tags."},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"Summary and Best Practices"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"Choose static inventories for static, predictable environments to reduce complexity. Transition to dynamic inventories when managing cloud-native infrastructure where host churn is high. Always verify your inventory configuration using the command 'ansible-inventory --list' to ensure all hosts are correctly targeted before executing playbooks."}]
